comment: Acceptance thresholds of the Ф1 perf gates (final-architecture.md §363-384). Keys are exact `<bench>.<metric>` names as printed by the bench scripts; values are MAXIMA. run-all.mjs --check fails when any metric exceeds its maximum. The `offthread.*` rows gate the durable path (commit work on the worker thread, Ф1 'not on the main thread'); `bridge.stallP99Ms` is the explicit stall budget under which the bridge fallback stays acceptable.
